static_traits.name: Li Wensen
static_traits.social_status: Has friends to chat with, but ashamed to admit Self-doubt, has not yet discussed Self-doubt about photography with friends; friendships affected, often seeking others' comfort and recognition
static_traits.medical_history: Similar Self-doubt appeared in the past when receiving negative feedback; never received psychotherapy; without significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, rather negative tone; often uses absolutist expressions (such as 'never will' 'always not good enough'); tends to negate praise; good cooperation

basic_info.main_problem: I often negate my achievements as a Photographer; whenever photos do not meet Anticipation I feel I am not good enough.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing Self-doubt is affecting my love for photography and blocking creativity, so hoping to reduce Self-doubt through counseling and rediscover passion and creativity for photography.
growth_experiences: Receiving negative feedback on a photographic work several years ago triggered intense shock and Depression, then gradually developed into a pattern of Self-doubt over every mistake (such as 'if I cannot do well now, I will never do well'), and since then focusing more on avoiding failure than enjoying the process in creative work.

Before the negative feedback, had published photos in magazines many times and felt proud of it; the past state was more confident, liking to try and learn, daring to experiment and grow from mistakes; these experiences of success and confidence are downplayed or regarded as 'luck' in the current self-doubt.

core_beliefs: I am not a good enough Photographer

special_situations.event: Photos overexposed or overall effect not yet reaching Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the work has flaws, it means my ability is insufficient; failure equals not being good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids picking up the camera and trying new things to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a terrible Photographer; I will never improve

special_situations.event: Receiving negative feedback on one's work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot do well now, I cannot do well in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Comparing with others, seeking others' recognition to try to relieve Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I cannot do well now, I cannot do well later either

special_situations.event: Seeing other Photographers' works or thinking others are more talented
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others are more outstanding, it proves I am inferior and worth less
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently compares with others to gauge one's own level
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone else is more talented than me; my works are never good enough

special_situations.event: Friends praising or supporting one's work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If praise is not strict and objective, it does not count and has no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating praise, insisting on proving oneself not good enough with mistakes and inadequacies
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just trying to make me feel better; this is not sincere or not worth referencing

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be professionally recognized and affirmed, maintaining self-worth and creativity as a Photographer
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being negated, worrying that exposing 'not being good enough' will bring shame and loss of self-esteem
defense_goal: Lowering shame and Anxiety by avoiding attempts, negating praise and seeking external validation, maintaining fragile self-worth

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough creator needing external recognition
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges or others who seem supportive but are not sincere
Others more talented, making oneself pale in comparison

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When works have not yet reached Anticipation or upon Receiving negative feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing one failure as a negation of all ability, believing this proves 'I am not good enough'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Steady and non-judgmental tone, first empathizing with their shame and frustration, inviting concrete evidence and counterexamples; using gentle challenges, distinguishing one mistake from overall ability.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When friends give praise and support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing the other person is only comforting oneself, praise is not genuine and has no value
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintaining an accepting attitude, reflecting their experience of 'finding compliments hard to believe', inviting them to break down the specific content and source of the compliments, carrying out reality testing and meaning reconstruction.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing others' better works or thinking of peers' talents
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Seeing others' strengths as a total negation of oneself, sinking into comparison and despair
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle tone, receiving self-criticism with empathy, encouraging distinguishing others' strengths from one's own growth path; using concretization and timeline methods, identifying small controllable improvements.

manifestations: Self-doubt turns creation from 'enjoying the process' into 'avoiding failure'; success is seen as luck, making self-affirmation hard
Living alone but not yet discussing real Self-doubt and shame with friends
Seeks external approval but finds it hard to feel truly understood
outcomes: Support resources not yet effectively utilized

manifestations: Avoiding directly discussing Self-doubt about photography with friends
When praise appears, turns to emphasize failures and mistakes, avoiding contact with positive information

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial (such as 'I will never get better')
Before creating, overly worries about failure and gives up trying

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Believing friends' praise is only for comfort and not genuine, attributing inner distrust to others' motives

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Turns creative energy into self-criticism and self-blame
No longer actively trying new techniques or experiments, turning to Self-denial

exception_events.target_problem: When works have not yet reached Anticipation, the client usually engages in Self-denial, struggling to recognize achievements and losing motivation to shoot.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When several photos were published by magazines, the client felt proud and briefly recognized their own ability, did not see success as accidental, thereby relieving Self-doubt.
exception_events.reason: Different situation/support: receiving clear professional recognition and concrete outcome feedback, providing objective evidence of ability, making it easier to accept positive information.

Has had works published in magazines, with objective successful experiences
Willing to try counseling and cooperate in exploring thinking patterns
Able to recall and identify specific past situations of success and failure
negative_force: Over-reliance on external validation and comparison
Negating positive feedback, focusing on mistakes (mental filtering/negating the positive)
Cognitive tendencies toward black-and-white thinking and overgeneralization
Failure Fear leading to avoiding attempts, Decreased drive
Ashamed to express real troubles to friends, support not yet effectively utilized

target_behavior.behavior: Severe Self-denial and Anxiety when works have errors or do not reach Anticipation
antecedent: Photos overexposed or technical/aesthetic mistakes occur
target_behavior.core_reason: Forming a catastrophic and overgeneralized cognitive chain after negative feedback, seeing one mistake as overall insufficient ability and inevitable future failure.
target_behavior.function: Escaping the shame and Anxiety brought by failure, trying to gain a sense of control and prevent future mistakes through self-criticism.
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in creative motivation, Blocked creativity, Professional performance affected; daily routines and Work schedules disrupted.

target_behavior.behavior: Seeking others' comfort and external validation while negating praise
antecedent: Communicating with friends and receiving praise after feeling dissatisfied with works
Feeling uneasy when thinking others are more talented
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-worth depending on external recognition, while negating positive information due to the inner 'not good enough' core belief to maintain cognitive consistency.
target_behavior.function: Briefly relieving unease and confirming self-positioning; avoiding the inconsistency and insecurity brought by acknowledging self-worth through negating praise.
target_behavior.consequence: Friendships are affected, support effects are limited; self-esteem declines further, doubt persists.

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids picking up the camera and trying new things before creating or after failure
antecedent: Anticipating possible failure or recalling past negative feedback
Comparing with excellent works produces frustration
target_behavior.core_reason: Avoidance driven by failure Fear and shame, believing 'if I cannot do well now, I will not do well in the future'.
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome emotions (shame/Anxiety), reducing the risk of facing failure.
target_behavior.consequence: Creative practice and skill improvement hindered, Career development and Decline in creativity.
